title: Facilitating Adoption of AI in Energy Generation Sector
what_it_is: Facilitating Adoption of AI in Energy Generation Sector

sections.label: AI in energy sector
sections.summary: EMA launched a VPP regulatory sandbox, uses AI for solar forecasting, and Enterprise Singapore supports an AI cost and carbon reduction programme for SMEs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: In 2025, the Energy Market Authority (EMA) launched a regulatory sandbox for Virtual Power Plants (VPPs), which are essentially, digital platforms that control, optimise and aggregate distributed energy resources, such as solar panels and battery energy storage systems.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: VPP pilots may utilise AI to forecast renewable generation output and optimise generation capacity based on prevailing wholesale market conditions.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: EMA has also incorporated AI within its internal energy management systems to support solar forecasting.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: For example, Enterprise Singapore supports the Singapore Business Federation's Cost and Carbon Reduction Programme.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: The programme utilises a proprietary AI tool to help small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) identify cost reduction and decarbonisation opportunities, including through energy conservation and efficiency measures.

sections.label: Skills Framework for Energy and Power
sections.summary: The Skills Framework for Energy and Power, developed by SkillsFuture Singapore, Workforce Singapore and EMA with industry and union partners, maps key roles and competencies including digital and data skills.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: For example, we have the Skills Framework for Energy and Power developed by SkillsFuture Singapore, Workforce Singapore and EMA with industry and union partners, mapping out the key roles and required competencies, including digital and data skills.

sections.label: Studying AI solutions from other countries
sections.summary: Singapore recognises AI as a strong power sector enabler and is studying AI solutions other countries deployed, such as predictive maintenance and machine learning for operational efficiency.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: We recognise that AI is a strong enabler in the power sector and that other countries could be more advanced than us in the adoption of AI.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: We are studying various AI solutions, which other countries have deployed for both energy generation and the grid network.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: Some examples include the use of AI for predictive maintenance of energy assets and the application of machine learning to enhance the operational efficiency of both traditional and renewable energy sources.
